# Events

The pod's event catalog: the 29 event types an automation trigger can name.

## Catalog

### Entity

| Event type                    | Name           | Description                                                                                                 | Filter keys                                                                                                  |
| ----------------------------- | -------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `entity.create.completed`     | Entity created | Fires after any entity is successfully created.                                                             | `profileSlug`                                                                                                |
| `entity.update.completed`     | Entity updated | Fires after any entity field or property is updated.                                                        | `profileSlug`, `changedKeys`, `changed.<fieldName>`, `previous.<fieldName>`, `<fieldName>`                   |
| `entity.transition.completed` | Status changed | Fires when a thing's lifecycle status moves (the kind's own, or a role's), through the one moveStatus door. | `lifecycleProfile`, `profileSlug`, `role`, `property`, `from`, `to`, `fromCategory`, `category`, `actorKind` |
| `entity.delete.completed`     | Entity deleted | Fires after an entity is permanently deleted.                                                               | `profileSlug`                                                                                                |

## System events

- `webhooks.deliver.requested`

## Naming grammar

Event types follow `{subject}.{action}.{phase}`.

- Subjects (record changes): `entity`, `document`, `workspace`, `view`, `relation`, `link`, `tag`, `project`, `proposal`, `message`, `user`, `role`, `apiKey`, `skill`, `agent`, `agentRun`, `chatThread`, `template`, `inboxItem`, `sharing`, `workspaceMember`, `projectMember`
- Actions: `create`, `update`, `delete`, `archive`, `restore`
- Phases: `requested`, `validated`, `completed`, `denied`
- Subjects whose action is a domain verb: `command`, `external_channel`, `external_webhook`, `focus_session`, `hydration`, `inbox_item`, `messaging_account`, `notification`, `tool`, `connection_sync`, `track`, `entity_facet`
- Connector and system families: `external_message`, `channel_message`, `connector_sync`, `capture`, `proactive`, `feed`
- Message alias patterns: `message.received`, `message.received.*`, `message.sent`, `message.sent.*`, `message.*`
- Observation namespaces: `dev`, `ci`

Automation trigger patterns accept an exact type (`entity.create.completed`), an action wildcard (`entity.create.*`) or a subject wildcard (`entity.*`).
